Subject: Q3 Exec Briefing — urgent: board asks to move date

Hi Alex,

Apologies for the late message — we've just been pulled into an emergency board call for Monday related to a regulatory filing and our exec team is no longer available for the Q3 on-site you planned for Tuesday (10/13).

We absolutely want to keep the briefing but need one of the following:
- Push the on-site by one full week (next Tues 10/20) if your team can accommodate, or
- Convert Tuesday's session to a 90-minute remote exec briefing (same time) so senior leaders can join from the call, with an in-person follow-up later.

Could you confirm what works? We realize this is LN (last-minute) — genuinely sorry. We value the plan you put together (agenda attached). If neither option works we'll need to agree next steps quickly.

Thanks,
Sarah

We can support both options. Quick details so you can decide:
- Move to 10/20 in-person: our team has core presenters available on 10/20 AM; we can keep the same agenda and shift the hands-on segment to a late-afternoon working session. Travel-wise, my flight is refundable but non-instant; travel ops tells me we can rebook with a small fare difference — I'll loop them below.
- Convert to 90m remote on 10/13: we can compress to a 90-minute exec briefing and record a follow-up deep dive for engineers within two weeks. We'll drop the live demo or run a brief pre-recorded demo to save time.

If you prefer the remote option, we'll confirm an updated deck and meeting link by EOD Monday. If you want 10/20, can you confirm by EOD today so I can lock travel and hotels?

I copied Evelyn (customer success) and Markus (ops) to handle logistics and ensure there are no billing/credit surprises if we cancel any vendor bookings.

Thanks — Alex
